steps.text: project-mmo: key.pmmo.openMenu (default P) opens the Glossary only while no screen is up

project-mmo: the glossary layout registers its CollapsingPanel before the search bar inside it, and the panel is itself a focusable widget, so the first Tab stops on the panel and the second reaches the bar
project-mmo: type the pinyin of 石头 (shi tou); the item panels compare their display name with the typed filter
